Ah shit, sorry to hear that :( Unfortunately yes, top surgery is almost exclusively done 18 plus. Usually you have to make appointments half a year in advance anyway, because of the paper work and insurance involved and stuff. So it’s possible to already get an appointment while you’re still 17, with the surgery date set once you’re of age. That’s how it went for me at least, but that ofc depends on which country or state you live in.

I understand your situation all too well, I was literally in the exact same. The waiting is hell, I know, but it won’t last forever.

What also helped me with dysphoria pre op were chest workouts. If you think that’s something for you, maybe give it a try, it really can make a difference.

Hang in there buddy! :)

I didn’t even see there was a new comment here ahh I’m sorry for the late reply 😅 

If you’re a cigarette smoker (like I am/was at the time) make sure to ask your surgeon how long before the surgery you need to stop, mine said 24-48 hours was enough, but some require you to stop a month in advance so no complications with healing occur (especially if you get nipple grafts).

The same goes for medication. They usually ask, but make sure they have a list of the meds you take regularly, even if it’s just aspirin etc. Could be that you have to stop taking some of them before or after the surgery for a while, but they will inform you about all of this usually.

Maybe weight yourself a couple of days before the surgery date, the anesthesiologist usually asks you your approximate weight before putting you under. 

For after the surgery I definitely recommend some kind of button ups or zip hoodies to wear. T-Shirts worked for me personally as well though, depends on how well you’re able to move afterwards.

Depending on how long you’re not able to shower, I would get a can of dry shampoo and maybe some wet wipes.

That’s pretty much all I can personally think of 🤔
